question: Sashastra Seema Bal is the lead intelligence unit for the ________ and Bhutan borders and the coordinating agency for national security activities.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB)** is the lead intelligence unit for the **Nepal** and Bhutan borders.
 
• SSB is responsible for preventing trans-border crimes, smuggling, and any other illegal activities across these borders.
 
• It also plays a crucial role in ensuring the security and safety of the border areas, working in coordination with other security agencie
